title: Global existence and uniqueness of strong solutions for a viscoelastic coupled system of two wave equations
author: Houda Fadel, Djamila Benterki, Salim A. Messaoudi
work: Existence and stability of solutions for a viscoelastic coupled system of two wave equations
source_version: Electronic Journal of Differential Equations, Vol. 2026 (2026), No. 16, pp. 1--23; DOI 10.58997/ejde.2026.16; published February 19, 2026; publisher version
difficulty_reason: With Lemmas 2.1 and 2.2, the Poincare and Sobolev tools and the smallness hypothesis on the coupling constant available as context, the counted theorem still requires the whole Faedo-Galerkin construction for a coupled system in which only the first wave equation carries the memory term. The author has to build the approximate solutions on the span of the Dirichlet eigenfunctions, propagate uniform higher-order energy estimates through the memory kernel and through the coupling, extract weakly and weak-star convergent subsequences, identify the limit of the nonlinear memory term, pass the initial data to the limit, and then prove uniqueness by testing the difference of two solutions with the time derivatives of both components and combining Young and Poincare inequalities inside an admissible range of the auxiliary parameter. Well-posedness of this coupled viscoelastic system is a nontrivial research argument rather than a qualification exercise, even though the method is classical.
